title: Conformal Field Theory Realizations of Subfactors
exact_target: Can every subfactor be realized by a conformal field theory?

status_qualification: The primary contribution (PDF page 5, printed page 853) supplies the finite-index and realization qualifications omitted from the abbreviated catalogue sentence. ID 30004278 revisits the same broad construction programme, and ID 30002840 is the Asaeda--Haagerup instance; equivalence of every realization convention has not been established.
